picks.title: Apple patent describes AI that repaints app screenshots per keyword
picks.rationale: Apple's patent sets out keyword-by-keyword generative App Store creative: diffusion models repaint each screenshot to match the search term. That points to a new way of doing app-install ad creative and search optimization.
picks.excerpt: An Apple patent describes three Stable Diffusion models that redraw everything but the headline and phone mockup in App Store marketing images, so each search keyword gets its own screenshot creative; dependent claims let the keywords come from the app itself.

picks.title: LeBron James Takes Legal Action Over AI Ad That Crossed a Line
picks.rationale: LeBron James's representatives are demanding that a viral AI-generated ad for the sports-betting app 'Bron AI' be pulled because it used his likeness without permission. It is a concrete legal action against AI-made ad creative and a warning for anyone generating celebrity-style spots.
picks.excerpt: LeBron James's representatives are pushing back against a viral AI-generated ad for sports-betting app 'Bron AI' that used his likeness without permission, demanding it stop.

picks.title: Japanese pizza chain apologizes after TikTok AI tool creates unauthorized Dr. STONE ad
picks.rationale: PIZZA-LA paused all its TikTok advertising after TikTok's automatic AI ad feature generated an unapproved video using licensed anime IP. It is a new brand-safety incident and a concrete reason to audit auto-generated creative settings.
picks.excerpt: PIZZA-LA paused all TikTok advertising after a TikTok AI-powered ad feature generated an unapproved video for its Dr. STONE anime collaboration campaign, and apologized to the rights holders.

picks.title: AI로 광고 만들고 카톡 추천 강화… 수익 끌어올리는 네카오
picks.rationale: From Nov 12 to 19, Naver pilots an 'AI copy generation' feature in its Power Link search ads that writes ad text from the advertiser's assets and landing page. This is a new ad-creative tool on Korea's largest search ad platform.
picks.excerpt: 네이버가 11월 12~19일 검색광고 '파워링크'에 광고주가 등록한 소재와 연결 웹페이지를 AI가 분석해 광고 문구를 만들어 주는 'AI 문구 생성' 기능을 시범 적용하고, 카카오는 카톡 추천을 강화하는 등 네카오가 AI로 광고 수익성 강화에 나섰다.

picks.title: 몰로코, '몰로콘 26' 개최…AI 광고 시스템 카라로 앱·CTV·커머스 공략
picks.rationale: At Molocon 26, Moloco took its AI ad system Cara beyond mobile apps into CTV and commerce ads. That gives performance advertisers a new open-internet buying option.
picks.excerpt: 몰로코가 11월 5일 서울에서 '몰로콘 26'을 열고 AI 광고 시스템 '카라(Cara)'로 모바일 앱을 넘어 CTV·커머스 광고까지 확장하는 오픈 인터넷 광고 전략을 발표했다.
